svg.title: Illustrative discount on a labelled 100 dollar order
svg.desc: Bars show the published discount on a labelled 100 dollars of eligible pre-tax merchandise. Chewy first Autoship is 20 dollars because 20 percent meets the 20 dollar cap. Pet Valu pickup first order is 10 dollars. A 5 percent recurring or ship-to-home discount is 5 dollars. PetSmart Treats base earning is 2 dollars, because 1,000 points equal 2 dollars. This is not a shopped basket and not a ranking.
svg.text: Discount on a labelled $100, not a basket
Rules opened 26 Sep 2026. A longer bar is a larger published discount on this example only.
Scale: $20 = 400 px. Chewy 20 percent of $100 is $20, which meets the CA $20 cap. On $150 the cap still holds at $20.
The 5 percent bar is Pet Valu ship-to-home, or a later select-brand or recurring discount. It is not 5 percent of a mixed cart.
PetSmart: 10 points per $1 is 1,000 points, and 1,000 points equal $2 on a later purchase. Bestie and VIPP are not drawn.
Costco, Walmart, and Amazon.ca are off the chart. No comparable program percent was opened for them. Not a ranking.
Saving Optimizer, 26 Sep 2026. Illustrative arithmetic. The shelf price you write down is the price.
